title: Durable outbox and idempotent workers
scope: Implement persisted delivery attempts, retry limits and dead-letter/manual-retry state

acceptance.text: Implement persisted delivery attempts, retry limits and dead-letter/manual-retry state
Crash/replay jobs and prove no duplicate case or outward evidence request
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Crash/replay jobs and prove no duplicate case or outward evidence request

evidence.text: Vati Outbox Event/Attempt/Effect DocTypes persist delivery state, every attempt (committed before the handler runs), per-event max_attempts with bounded backoff, a dead_letter state, and operator retry_event/resolve_effect/release_effect (System Manager only). Observed on disposable site verify-20261104t085842 (frappe_dev.py verify, tax019 stack): poison/backoff, permanent and missing-handler dead letters, bounded crash loop, and manual-retry rules (409 while in progress) all passed.

test_outbox_bench simulates worker crashes (BaseException plus rollback, then replay after lease expiry). Results: a crash after a committed local write left one canonical case. A crash after the outward call to a non-idempotent fake upstream, with reconcile, left exactly one Jube case and one evidence request, with no re-send. With an idempotent upstream it left one record. A crash after a completed effect made no second call. An unknown outcome dead-lettered instead of re-sending. A stale worker whose lease expired was fenced off before calling out. 18/18 outbox bench tests and 53/53 site tests passed; the site was dropped.

python3 scripts/dev.py check passed (120 Frappe-free app tests, 32 site tests skipped there); python3 scripts/quality.py passed (ruff, mypy, frontend); frappe_dev.py verify exit 0 with 53 site tests. ADR-008 records the design. PR opened for human review.
